}}'''Moressin Damodred''' was a [[Cairhien]]en nobleman. He was [[Laman Damodred|Laman Damodred's]] brother and [[Moiraine Damodred|Moiraine Damodred's]] uncle.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Moressin Damodred}}

== History ==
He was a very ambitious, angry and cruel man. He was contemptuous of Moiraine's father for being a scholar. He died with Laman during the [[Aiel War]].
